name: Gearhart Golf Links
architects: Front nine 1892, back nine 1913; links restoration 2013-15 (Wikipedia; unverified)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 428161-429385 / y 5097099-5099091, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release gearhart-data, exportImage.14.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release gearhart-data, exportImage.15.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

world.note: provisional: OSM boundary bbox (572 x 1,364 m) + 120 m each side, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (about 220 m of scenery on every side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 03/2020, 'Version 1'), GitHub release gearhart-data, supplied by the developer 2026-10-20. Every row adds up to its printed Out/In/Total. 'The Stones' is stored as Stones. The card prints no rating or slope: men's ratings from GolfPass (golfpass.com/travel-advisor/courses/51-gearhart-golf-links/scorecard-and-layout, retrieved 2026-10-20; unverified). GolfPass also lists a Craic set (5,896) that is not on the card, and its White row differs from the card only on hole 7 (273 against the card's 328; GolfPass's White holes add to 5,686). Stones, Black and Green agree hole by hole. Full card with the ladies' handicap row in scorecard_full.csv
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Imagery check: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): Black tees only, all water red (Neacoxie Creek, w422896233, by the 6th and 8th tees: red_water_osm), OB = the OSM boundary, wind 3-14 mph (open coast), theme pnw. Developer 2026-10-20 (intake answers): holes 14-16 renumbered (edits.json); the card's local rule applies, so Gearhart Lane (ob_highways tertiary) and the three parking lots (cut out of the boundary, edits.json) are out of bounds; lidar trees no longer standing in the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped (drop_trees).
